steps.title: Initialize Project Structure & App Metadata
steps.description: Configured core application meta settings, canvas viewport layout, and basic project configuration.

steps.title: Define Generic API Schema & Leaderboard Rules
steps.description: Defined backend collections for scores, garage progress, and dynamic local calculation logic.

steps.title: Build HTML UI Shell & HUD Canvas Container
steps.description: Constructed responsive HTML structure, overlay HUD, speedometer, mini-map container, and touch control layout.

steps.title: Design Tailwind CSS Styling & Neon Synthwave Theme
steps.description: Applied dark high-tech styling, arcade glowing UI elements, animations, and responsive screen sizing.

steps.title: Implement Synthesized Web Audio API Engine
steps.description: Created procedural sound synthesizers for V8 engine pitch shifts, turbo whines, tire screeches, and synthwave soundtrack.

steps.title: Develop Pseudo-3D Perspective Camera & Segment Renderer
steps.description: Built sub-pixel projection engine handling road depth, dynamic camera pitch/yaw, vertical hills, and curving tracks.

steps.title: Render 3D Polygon Vehicles & Dynamic Physics Engine
steps.description: Implemented procedural 3D car mesh drawing with chassis roll, steering angles, suspension pitch, dynamic shadows, and tail lights.

steps.title: Generate Dynamic Track Environments & Scenery
steps.description: Constructed multiple track tracks (Neon Cyber City, Alpine Ridge, Sunset Freeway, Canyon Run) with roadside trees, streetlights, and tunnels.

steps.title: Program AI Opponents & Collision Physics
steps.description: Added multi-car AI traffic, dynamic lane switching, drafting mechanics, particle spark collisions, and position ranking logic.

steps.title: Implement Drift Counter, Nitro Boost & Particle Systems
steps.description: Engineered high-speed drift accumulation, nitro exhaust flare graphics, motion blur camera shake, and score multipliers.

steps.title: Integrate Garage Upgrades, Local Persistence & Cloud Leaderboards
steps.description: Added car purchasing, upgrade stats system, authentication module, and high-score cloud sync API.

steps.title: Building apex3dracing
steps.description: Performed final pre-flight checks, input bindings validation, sound balance adjustments, and performance optimizations.
